English: Cool Cellar Hut
A humble, sunken hut used to store perishables safely in the desert heat.
Sandbreak Pavilion
A basic windbreak made of woven mats, providing essential shelter from the ever-present desert sand.
Water Skin Rack
A simple rack for hanging and drying waterskins, ensuring a basic supply for the first settlers.
Oasis Shelter
Makeshift lean-tos and windbreaks, providing basic protection from sandstorms and desert nights.
Camel Tether Post
A rough post for tethering camels, marking the beginnings of horde mobility and organization.
Palm Shade Tent
Simple tents woven from palm leaves, providing minimal shade and comfort for the first arrivals at the oasis.
Desert Market Patch
A few rugs and stalls for bartering goods among the first oasis dwellers.
Date Grove
A handful of wild date palms, offering fruit and shade to the earliest settlers.
Deep Cellar Storage
A deeper, stone-lined storage hut, keeping grains and food safe from spoilage.
Desert Well
A hand-dug, shallow well, barely sustaining the small camp with its meager but life-saving water.
Large Water Rack
Expanded racks and shaded storage for more waterskins, making long journeys possible for more clanspeople.
Cloth Sandbreak Pavilion
A reinforced shelter using heavy cloth and reeds, keeping morale high during harsh weather.
Oasis Stronghold
A modest, earthen barricade, providing a sense of security to the first oasis dwellers.
Canvas Shelters
Sturdier canvas shelters, offering greater comfort and safety to the growing clan.
Camel Corral
A simple corral and feeding area, enabling a larger and healthier herd for the horde.
Palm Shade Pavilion
Improved tents with multiple layers of palm thatch, providing greater respite from the desert sun for growing families.
Oasis Trading Stalls
A collection of trading stalls, drawing traders from nearby settlements and nomad bands.
Cultivated Date Orchard
An expanded and cared-for orchard, providing reliable food and small trade goods.
Brick-Lined Well
A reinforced and deeper well, providing more reliable water for the growing nomad population.
Cellar Granary
A communal underground granary with guarded access, preventing famine and loss.
Waterskin Depot
A dedicated depot for storing and repairing waterskins, supporting large expeditions and trade caravans.
Palisade Stronghold
A palisade of timber and thornbush, encircling the oasis and providing greater defense in times of need.
Windproof Dwellings
Semi-permanent dwellings with windbreak walls, forming a secure camp core.
Defended Sandbreak Pavilion
A large, centrally placed pavilion offering both shelter and a command post for leaders.
Palm Lodge Encampment
A permanent cluster of multi-family palm lodges, forming the heart of the camp and promoting unity among the clans.
Covered Oasis Well
A well with a sturdy cover and rudimentary filtration, ensuring clean water for people and beasts alike.
Horde Camel Pens
Enclosed pens with shade and water, supporting a large number of riding and pack camels for war and trade.
Desert Caravan Market
A thriving market, hosting regular caravans, fairs, and fostering trade routes.
Subterranean Storehouse
An expansive, multi-chambered storehouse, ensuring food security and wealth for the largest clans.
Oasis Date Plantation
A large plantation of date palms, supplying food, trade, and attracting more population.
Oasis Water Reserve
A vast, shaded reserve for vast numbers of waterskins, supporting great migrations and horde movement across the desert.
Oasis Grand Pavilion
Spacious, semi-permanent pavilions with reinforced canopies, supporting large gatherings and enhancing the camps prestige.
Grand Sandbreak Hall
A grand, fortified hall that forms the center of the camps defenses and command.
Oasis Barricade Quarter
Large, enclosed living quarters with defensive barricades, safeguarding the clans heart.
Stone-Bound Stronghold
A stone-reinforced stronghold with watchtowers, forming a true center of defense for the oasis.
Oasis Waterworks
A deep, stone-lined well with troughs and irrigation channels, supporting a thriving and populous camp.
Oasis Camel Enclosure
A fortified enclosure with feeding stations, allowing for the maintenance of a massive horde of camels for nomad warriors.
Great Oasis Bazaar
A bustling, fortified bazaar with permanent structures, establishing the oasis as a vital trade hub.
Royal Date Grove
A sprawling, irrigated date grove tended by many hands, fueling both prosperity and prestige.
Citadel of the Oasis
A formidable citadel of stone and timber, the pride of the desert and a beacon of unity for the clans.
